Sent by David at 16:42 - Hi David here again from the messaging team. Thanks for your patience today. Our engineers have now investigated the reports of an overhead cable laying on the ground, and have deemed it safe to restore power back to all 262 properties in the Vicarage Avenue area.

We're very sorry we had to turn your power off unexpectedly, and with so little warning. We usually provide much more notice if we can, but in a situation like this our first priority is the safety of the public and our staff.

We know that being without power can be especially difficult, so we're sorry for the outage. If your power is still off or if you have any questions, call our team on 08003163105.

Sent by David at 15:54 - Hi - thanks for bearing with us, I know a power cut can be very disruptive. We've had an update from our staff that there are now 12 properties still affected by the overhead cable that is laying on the ground, as they have managed to safely divert some power, which has restored power for 250 of our customers.

We'll keep sending text updates to everyone until all the power to your area is on. To stop receiving texts, just follow this link https://UKPN.short.gy/STOP to unsubscribe.

What will happen next?

Our staff have found a potentially dangerous situation involving reports of an overhead cable laying on the ground so have responded as quickly as possible and asked our control room to turn power off to the area using our high voltage network. This is why a wide area has lost electricity.

Our field teams are working to fix the issue as quickly as possible, and we'll start diverting power back to affected homes as soon as they advise us it's safe. You may notice your lights going on and off as we work to get as much power restored as we can.

Our staff work as quickly as they can, so you might not hear about everything we're doing, but we'll always try to give you the clearest information we have.

Sent by David at 15:16 - We're very sorry we've had to switch off your electricity. Our engineers have turned off the power in the Vicarage Avenue area in the interest of the public's health and safety. This is so they can investigate reports of an overhead cable that is on the ground.

If in the area, please take care and stay at least 10m away from the cable. 

However, based on an average for this kind of issue, our estimated time to have you back on is between 17:30 and 18:30. 

We'll keep you updated with our progress, but in the meantime our team are always here to talk on 105 if you have any questions or concerns.
